style_analysis.shared_module_structure: Extract constants to frontend/styles/gate-theme.ts (colors, spacings, base styles). UI Primitives in frontend/components/gates/ui/*.tsx. Style objects in gate-theme should be composable (e.g., baseButton + primaryVariant).

ActionButton.overrides: Accepts 'style' for local positioning/margin tweaks; maintains core branding internally.

SectionCard.overrides: Wraps children in standardized padding and background.

StatusBadge.overrides: Auto-detects variant based on status string (e.g., 'approved' -> success).

ConfirmDialog.overrides: Portal-based modal for critical gate actions (e.g., Confirm Manifest).

Toast.overrides: Ephemeral notification usually triggered via useToast() hook.

progress_integration: Enhance GateTaskStatus to use a thicker, animated progress bar. Consumers already provide systemId/gateKey; StatusBadge should pulse during 'running' state. Event flow: WebSocket -> WebSocketContext -> GateTaskStatus. Consumption via TaskEvent.progress (0-100). Add 'estimated time' label if available in payload.
batch_ux_design: EvidenceMatrixPanel: Add checkboxes to the Claim Review Queue list items. ManifestPanel: Add checkboxes to the Assets Metadata & QC table. Implementation: Use a local 'selectedIds' Set state. Add a top-level 'Bulk Actions' bar that appears when selectedIds.size > 0, offering 'Approve Selected' or 'Confirm QC Selected' buttons.
toast_architecture: React Context-based (ToastProvider) for global availability. Provide a useToast() hook that exposes showSuccess(msg) and showError(msg) methods. Simple queue management within the provider to handle multiple overlapping events.
migration_strategy: 1. Create gate-theme.ts and base primitives in ui/ folder. 2. Implement ToastProvider and wrap app in providers.tsx. 3. Update GateTaskStatus first for immediate visual impact. 4. Refactor FigurePlanPanel (simplest) to use primitives. 5. Progressively migrate G2-G5 panels, adding batch selection to Manifest and EvidenceMatrix panels during their respective migration turns.
constraints_discovered: Panels currently use localized state for drafts (e.g., metadataDrafts in ManifestPanel) - primitives must allow controlled input.
No existing UI library (Tailwind/MUI) means all primitives must be built from scratch using CSSProperties.
Existing selectors (workbenchSelectors.ts) must be maintained to ensure data consistency during UI refactor.
risks: Incomplete extraction of unique edge-case styles (e.g., specific field layouts in AnalysisPanel).
WebSocket event bursts could cause progress bar flickering if not debounced or smoothed.
Batch mutations on backend might have different error handling than single-item mutations.
